package_info.package_versions: Magento 1 (all versions, as platform is end-of-life)
package_info.why_malicious: The injected code is designed to steal payment card data from customers by skimming sensitive information during checkout and exfiltrating it to an attacker-controlled domain. The code is loaded via a compromised third-party domain and leverages SQL and PHP object injection to gain control of the store.

execution_context.file_location: Injected into Magento 1 frontend templates or JavaScript files via SQL/PHP object injection

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code loads a remote JavaScript file from naturalfreshmall.com, which captures payment form data entered by customers and sends it to the attacker's server, resulting in payment card data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Loading JavaScript from an unrelated, external domain on a payment page is a classic sign of a Magecart-style skimmer attack.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate Magento stores should only load scripts from trusted, first-party domains. Injecting third-party scripts into payment pages is not standard practice.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some stores use third-party analytics or payment processors, but these are well-known and vetted domains.
key_indicators: Script injected into sensitive payment workflow
No legitimate business relationship with the external domain

attack_chain.action: Attacker exploits SQL injection and PHP object injection vulnerabilities to gain write access to Magento store files.
attack_chain.leads_to: Ability to modify frontend templates or JavaScript files

attack_chain.action: Malicious script tag is injected into the checkout page or related frontend files.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of remote JavaScript on customer browsers

attack_chain.action: Remote JavaScript skimmer captures payment data and exfiltrates it to the attacker's server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Theft of customer payment card information (final goal)

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected external JavaScript loaded on checkout/payment pages
Network requests from customer browsers to untrusted domains during checkout
Modification of Magento frontend files outside of normal update cycles
file_indicators: Unusual changes in skin/frontend/base/default/js/ or template files
network_indicators: Outbound connections to naturalfreshmall.com from customer browsers
POST requests containing payment data to external domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unauthorized changes to Magento frontend files, especially those that add external script tags. Use web application firewalls to detect and block SQL/PHP object injection attempts. Analyze network traffic from checkout pages for requests to untrusted domains. Regularly scan for the presence of known skimmer domains in page source code.
